_comment: Evaluation scenarios. Passive and PPO are run with the SAME env config, road, speed, seed, options and initial state. Seeds >= 100000 are never used in training or model selection. 'deterministic' scenarios have no random element, so 1 seed suffices.

scenarios.name: smooth_A_15
scenarios.note: ISO class A (very smooth) at 15 m/s; class A is NOT in the training mixture

scenarios.name: flat_perturbed
scenarios.note: flat road, body displaced +20 mm at t=0 (free-decay test); identical for both controllers

scenarios.name: bump_10
scenarios.note: Stage 1 'bump' preset: raised cosine h=0.04 m, L=2.5 m, start 10 m, 10 m/s

scenarios.name: heldout_bump_tall
scenarios.note: taller/longer/faster than any training bump (train: h<=0.04, L<=3, v<=14)

scenarios.name: heldout_rough_D_10
scenarios.note: ISO class D (not in training) at 10 m/s

scenarios.name: heldout_test_mixture
scenarios.note: Stage 1 'test' mixture: tall bump / ISO A at 22-28 m/s / ISO D at 8-12 m/s (speed arg ignored by the mixture)
